obligations.law_title: Relates to the canvassing of absentee, military and special ballots and ballots cast in affidavit envelopes; repealer

obligations.action_summary: Refrain from publicly announcing or releasing unofficial tabulations until after the polls close on election day.
obligations.quote: no unofficial tabulations of election results shall be publicly announced or released in any manner until after the close of polls on election day at which time such tabulations shall be added into the election night vote totals
obligations.law_title: Relates to the canvassing of absentee, military and special ballots and ballots cast in affidavit envelopes; repealer

obligations.action_summary: Verify, tally and record the results of the remaining valid ballots for each election district.
obligations.quote: the central board of canvassers shall thereupon, as nearly as practicable in the manner provided in this article for absentee, military and special ballots, verify the number of ballots so cast, tally the votes so cast, add such tally to the previous tally of all votes cast in such election district, and record the result.
obligations.law_title: Relates to the canvassing of absentee, military and special ballots and ballots cast in affidavit envelopes; repealer

obligations.action_summary: Preserve the record of the vote counted by each scanner and manually, by election district, for the same period as the returns of canvass.
obligations.quote: The record of the vote counted by each scanner and manually for each candidate and for and against each ballot proposal, printed by election district, shall be preserved in the same manner and for the same period as the returns of canvass for the election.
obligations.law_title: Relates to the canvassing of absentee, military and special ballots and ballots cast in affidavit envelopes; repealer

obligations.action_summary: Review all affidavit ballots cast in an election within four business days of the election.
obligations.quote: Within four business days of the election, the board of elections shall review all affidavit ballots cast in the election.
obligations.law_title: Relates to the canvassing of absentee, military and special ballots and ballots cast in affidavit envelopes; repealer

obligations.action_summary: Cast and canvass an affidavit ballot when the voter was entitled to vote, applying the rule for competing absentee ballots.
obligations.quote: If the central board of canvassers determines that a person was entitled to vote at such election it shall cast and canvass such affidavit ballot
obligations.law_title: Relates to the canvassing of absentee, military and special ballots and ballots cast in affidavit envelopes; repealer

obligations.action_summary: Cast and canvass an affidavit ballot of an entitled voter who appeared at the correct polling place, even in the wrong election district or absent from the registration poll record.
obligations.quote: the board shall cast and canvass such affidavit ballot if such board finds that the voter appeared at the correct polling place, regardless of the fact that the voter may have appeared in the incorrect election district
obligations.law_title: Relates to the canvassing of absentee, military and special ballots and ballots cast in affidavit envelopes; repealer

obligations.action_summary: Cast and canvass the affidavit ballot of a voter who registered through the electronic voter registration transmittal system and signed the affidavit.
obligations.quote: the board shall cast and canvass such affidavit ballot if the voter is otherwise qualified to vote in such election.
obligations.law_title: Relates to the canvassing of absentee, military and special ballots and ballots cast in affidavit envelopes; repealer

obligations.action_summary: Cast and canvass an affidavit ballot where the voter substantially complied with the election law.
obligations.quote: the board shall cast and canvass such affidavit ballot if such board finds that the voter substantially complied with the requirements of this chapter.
obligations.law_title: Relates to the canvassing of absentee, military and special ballots and ballots cast in affidavit envelopes; repealer

obligations.action_summary: Cast and canvass an affidavit ballot despite a missing prior-registration address when the statewide voter registration list identifies the voter.
obligations.quote: failure by the voter to include on the affidavit ballot envelope the address where such voter was previously registered shall not be a fatal defect and the board shall cast and canvass such affidavit ballot.
obligations.law_title: Relates to the canvassing of absentee, military and special ballots and ballots cast in affidavit envelopes; repealer

obligations.action_summary: Enter information into the ballot tracking system so an affidavit-ballot voter can determine whether the vote was counted.
obligations.quote: The board of elections shall enter information into the ballot tracking system, as defined in section 8-414 of this chapter, to allow a voter who cast a ballot in an affidavit envelope to determine if the vote was counted.
obligations.law_title: Relates to the canvassing of absentee, military and special ballots and ballots cast in affidavit envelopes; repealer

obligations.action_summary: Within four business days of the election, designate a central board of canvassers and meet to review invalid, undeliverable and uncured absentee, military and special ballots.
obligations.quote: Within four business days of the election, the board of elections shall designate itself or such of its employees to act as a central board of canvassers as provided in subdivision one of this section and meet to review absentee, military and special ballots
obligations.law_title: Relates to the canvassing of absentee, military and special ballots and ballots cast in affidavit envelopes; repealer

obligations.action_summary: Send notice of the post-election review meeting by first class mail at least five days beforehand to each candidate, party and independent body entitled to watchers.
obligations.quote: At least five days prior to the time fixed for such meeting, the board shall send notice by first class mail to each candidate, political party, and independent body entitled to have had watchers present at the polls in any election district in the board's jurisdiction.
obligations.law_title: Relates to the canvassing of absentee, military and special ballots and ballots cast in affidavit envelopes; repealer

obligations.action_summary: Review ballot envelopes set aside as invalid, returned as undeliverable, or with curable defects not timely cured.

obligations.law_title: Relates to the canvassing of absentee, military and special ballots and ballots cast in affidavit envelopes; repealer

obligations.action_summary: Promulgate rules and regulations necessary to implement the canvassing of absentee, military, special and affidavit ballots.

obligations.law_title: Relates to the canvassing of absentee, military and special ballots and ballots cast in affidavit envelopes; repealer

obligations.action_summary: Audit the central count ballot scanners within three days of any election by auditing ballots from three percent of tabulated election districts.

obligations.law_title: Relates to the canvassing of absentee, military and special ballots and ballots cast in affidavit envelopes; repealer

obligations.action_summary: Reconvene and adjust the canvass when a later scanner audit meets the criteria to replace the canvass.

obligations.action_summary: Hold at least two public hearings over no more than thirty days on district composition before drawing a draft plan.
obligations.quote: Before drawing a draft districting or redistricting plan or plans of the proposed boundaries of the districts, the political subdivision shall hold at least two public hearings over a period of no more than thirty days, at which the public is invited to provide input regarding the composition of the districts.
obligations.law_title: Relates to the John R. Lewis Voting Rights Act of New York

obligations.action_summary: Publish at least one draft districting plan, and the potential sequence of staggered elections, once drafts are drawn.
obligations.quote: After all draft districting or redistricting plans are drawn, the political subdivision shall publish and make available for release at least one draft districting or redistricting plan
obligations.law_title: Relates to the John R. Lewis Voting Rights Act of New York

obligations.action_summary: Hold at least two additional hearings over no more than forty-five days on the content of the draft plans.
obligations.quote: The political subdivision shall also hold at least two additional hearings over a period of no more than forty-five days, at which the public shall be invited to provide input regarding the content of the draft districting or redistricting plan or plans
obligations.law_title: Relates to the John R. Lewis Voting Rights Act of New York

obligations.action_summary: Publish draft plans at least seven days before a hearing, and publish revised versions at least seven days before adoption.

obligations.law_title: Relates to the John R. Lewis Voting Rights Act of New York
